prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / character-design sheet.
Make ONE polished wide landscape CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for the Nihao Agent avatar asset pack. This is an explanatory concept image, NOT an animation sprite.
Input image 1: approved head-and-shoulders pixel-art avatar identity reference. Input image 2: approved full-body front master, same character. Match these EXACTLY: cute chibi Chinese girl, one high black round bun, red hair ribbon with side bow, black side fringe, red Mandarin-collar short-sleeve qipao with yellow-gold edging and frog closures, modest knee-length skirt, black flats, no bag or shoulder strap. Keep consistent front-facing proportions, recognizable facial features, happy welcoming restrained expression, 2D crisp square-pixel illustration style.
Layout: wide 3:2 or 16:9 image with generous outside margins; left third a large full-body frontal figure using image 2; middle third a smaller head-and-shoulders closeup using image 1, with short neat dark-ink annotation leader lines; right third an orderly design-spec column. Exact top title: "NIHAO AGENT". Subtitle: "Character reference". Do NOT add a large background panel or opaque backdrop: all empty space is genuine alpha transparency. Use clean very readable sans-serif typography in dark brown ink #271015, fully opaque. The character stays pixel art; text stays clear and professional.
Required exact short annotation labels with precise spelling: "Single high bun", "Red ribbon", "Mandarin collar", "Gold frog closures".
Right column: six square solid color swatches with readable matching text labels:
"Scarlet  #E5182A"
"Gold  #F8CF32"
"Hair  #292229"
"Skin  #FFC9AC"
"Ink  #271015"
"Sapphire  #2459D5"
Below sapphire label add small exact note: "Brand accent only".
Below the swatches put two exact brand-personality lines: "Warm & welcoming" and "China travel companion".
Keep all text comfortably separated from character art, clear hierarchy and alignment, no overlapping labels. Entire composition transparent PNG, alpha background including between all elements. No giant colored panels, no mockups, no photo effects, no cast shadows, no 3D, no gradients, no extra characters, no props, no extra copy, no random symbols.
